plan.title: Validation Plan for CR-003 Credit Limit Assignment Strategy

checks.title: Kolmogorov-Smirnov Statistic on Test
checks.rationale: To assess the model's ability to discriminate between positive and negative outcomes.

checks.title: Kolmogorov-Smirnov Statistic on Out-of-Time
checks.rationale: To evaluate the model's performance on out-of-time data.

checks.title: Population Stability Index from Train to Out-of-Time
checks.rationale: To monitor the stability of the score distribution over time.

checks.title: Demographic Parity Difference in Approval Rate
checks.rationale: To ensure equitable approval rates across different PD bands.

checks.title: Rate of Missing Any Data
checks.rationale: To assess the completeness of the data used in the model.

checks.title: Share of Adverse Decisions
checks.rationale: To ensure that the model does not excessively decline applications.

checks.title: Monotonicity Check by PD Band
checks.rationale: To ensure that credit limits do not increase with higher PD bands.

plan.rationale: This validation plan covers performance, calibration, stability, fairness, data quality, and policy checks relevant to the CR-003 model. The thresholds are set based on industry standards to ensure the model's reliability and fairness.

data.summary: The validation plan for CR-003 includes checks for performance, calibration, stability, fairness, data quality, and policy adherence. Each check is designed to ensure the model meets industry standards and operates effectively across various metrics.
